content: Taweratsie Yawé taikɨ kemɨtiwareuyehɨa
Tawera metitetɨ 'ixaheritsixi 'axamekaniutiyuanekaitɨni Yawé hepaɨtsita mete'uka'eniwatɨ. Mɨkɨ waru'enieka waɨkawa kaniuyeha'ani, taikɨ wawarita mematiteitsie katinaxɨtsitɨatɨyani.
Hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi Muitsexi waɨkawa mekaniwawiriekaitɨni, kaniuyutanenewieni Yawé mɨtiwareuyehɨwirienikɨ, 'ana tai kaniutɨni.
'Ayumieme mana mɨya mɨtiɨyɨkɨ Tawera katiniuterɨwarieni, Yawé taikɨ mɨwarutitaiyaxɨkɨ.
Kiwuruti-Hatawa kiekatari kememɨteyu'uximatɨakai
Hipatɨ teɨteri kɨkamete memaye'ukai waɨkawa meteheukwaikɨtɨ mekanakɨne. Hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi mekaniutitsuani meta mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «Kemɨ'ane wai pɨtatsimini.
Titayari tsapari 'Ekipitutsie temɨwaretikwa'akai tekateyutuatɨ tetewareku'eiri. Yaxeikɨata pepinu meta meruni temetikwa'akai metatsiere wexu, 'uyuri meta 'axuxi.
Hikɨ neuxei tekananatiwawakini, manana xeikɨa tekanixeiyani».
Manana tsiranituru hatsiyari hepaɨ katiniyuxexeiyakaitɨni, witsuanari mutimerɨka hepaɨ.
'Ixaheritsixi mekanikuteɨxɨkaitɨni tetexi hutamekɨ mekanititɨxɨkaitɨni, yatɨni mekanititsunakaitɨni xɨka me'ika'etsakuni meta paa kɨmana mekaniwewiekaitɨni. Paa mɨwiyamarie hepaɨ kana'anekaitɨni.
Tɨkarikɨ kepauka haɨtsi mɨkaxɨrɨwekai memakuteitsie, manatsiere manana kanikaxɨrɨwekaitɨni.
Muitsexi Kiwuruti-Hatawa kemɨtiuyu'uximatɨa
Hikɨ Muitsexi kaniu'ena 'ixaheritsixi meta watɨɨriyama kememɨte'utsuanakai, yuxexuitɨ yuxamaru kitenie, Yawé mekanihaxɨatɨakaitɨni. Hikɨ yu'uximatɨatɨ,
Muitsexi Yawé kaniutahɨawe nenewierikɨ: —Xɨka ne neti'a'uximayatsiriwametɨni, ¿titayari peneti'uximatɨa? ¿titayari pekanetiparewie, teɨteri yunaitɨ nehetsie memɨte'uhɨpanikɨ penetihɨritɨa?
¿Netsɨ neniwema menehɨkɨ, neniwarutiniwexɨ, pemɨnetsi'aitɨakɨ kename newa'ɨwiyani, 'atɨɨriyama waweriyame hepaɨ, newarakatɨtɨ nemɨwareta'atɨanikɨ hakewa paitɨ kwie wa'ukiyarima pemɨwarexatɨatsie?
'Ikɨ yunaitɨ teɨteri wai mekaneniwawirieka me'utitsuatɨ. ¿Ne hakewa nepeikaxeiya?
Ne nexaɨtame nepɨkayɨwe 'ikɨ teɨteri wahetsiemieme. Waɨkawa 'uximayatsika pɨhɨkɨ nehetsiemieme.
Xɨka mɨpaɨ petiyurienemɨkɨ, ne nepɨmatsiwawirie netukari pemɨnetsi nawairienikɨ. Mɨpaɨ nepɨratɨmaiya hikɨ kenemɨtiuka'eniwa.
Yawé Muitsexi kemɨtiuta'ei

Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniuta'eiya: —'Ukirawetsixi 'ixaheritsixi haika tewiyari heimana tamamata kenene'atɨiri, mɨpaɨ ketinemaika yuteɨterima memɨwakuyuitɨwa xeikɨa mekaniyɨakakɨni. 'Ixuriki tukiyari manuwe keniwaranuwitɨki, mana 'etsiwa 'ahamatɨa yameketeheutewini.

Ne 'ahamatɨa nemɨtitaxatakɨ nekananukatemɨkɨ, mɨkɨ wahetsieta yanekatiniyurimɨkɨ 'iyari pemexeiya memexeiyanikɨ, memɨmatsiparewiekakɨ 'ikɨ teɨteri mɨmatsihɨritɨa wahekɨ. Mɨpaɨ 'ekɨ 'axaɨtame xeikɨa pemɨkayɨanenikɨ.

»Teɨteri xeikɨa mɨpaɨ pekatiniwatahɨawimɨkɨ: “Xekeneuyu'iti 'uxa'a miemekɨ, 'uxa'a wai xekanitikwaikuni. Xeme xekaniutitsuani Yawé hɨxie, mɨpaɨ xe'utiyuatɨ: ‘Wai ketatsi'umini. 'Ekipitutsie naime tepɨtehetikwa'akai.’ Mɨkɨta hikɨ wai kanixemimɨkɨ, xekanitikwaikuni.
Xeitukari, nihuta tukari ni'aɨxɨwime tukari, tamamata tukari, meta nixeitewiyari tukari xepɨka'itikwa'ani,
matsi xeimetseri, kepaukake xetsurita makanexɨani, kepaukake xemitixani'erieni. Yawé xemu'uximatɨakɨ, xehamatɨa muyeika, xemutitsuakɨ mɨpaɨ xe'utiyuatɨ: ‘¿Titayari 'Ekipitutsie tetehayekɨ?’”»
Kakaɨyari niukieya kanaye'atɨarieni
Muitsexi mɨpaɨta kaniutayɨni: —Ne kuyaxi 'ataxewime tsienituyari miriyari wahamatɨa nekaniuyeikani, ¿'ekɨta wai xeimetseritsie xeikɨa petiwamini peraine?
Tsepanetɨ xeikuraruyari tsipuru mɨwarukwi'iri mepɨkatenake, tsepanetɨ haramaratsie tsapari memuye'uwa yunaime mɨwarukwi'iri yunaitɨ mepɨkatenake.
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniuta'eiya: —¿Kamɨtsɨ Yawé tɨrɨkariyaya reu'atɨka? Hikɨtsɨ pekaninierimɨkɨ, xɨka neniuki nehaye'atɨamɨkɨ yatɨ pɨtikatixaɨ.

Hikɨ Muitsexi 'ixaheritsixi yakatiniwarutahɨawe Yawé kemɨtitahɨawekai. Mɨkɨ kaniwarukuxeɨrieni haika tewiyari heimana tamamata 'ukirawetsixi, wa'aurie kaniyuhayewa ta'ikwewatɨ 'ixuriki tukiyari 'aurie.

Yawé haitsie 'uyekaitɨ Muitsexi hamatɨa katiniutaxata, meta haika tewiyari heimana tamamata 'ukirawetsixi 'iyari kaniwarupitɨani Muitsexi meixeiyakai. Kepauka 'iyari wahetsie mɨyuhayewaxɨ, metekuxatatɨwetɨ mekanakɨne. Tawarita mɨpaɨ pɨkatiɨyɨ.

Yuhutatɨ 'ukirawetsixi yukie memuyuhayewakai. Xewitɨ 'Erirari titewatɨ, xewitɨta Merari. Tsepa memanayexeiyariekai tuki manuwe mepɨkahekɨ. Yatɨtɨ, 'iyari wahetsie pɨtiunakixɨ, mɨkɨta metekuxatatɨwetɨ mekanakɨne mematiteitsie.
Hikɨ xewitɨ temaikɨtɨtɨ kaniutanautsa Muitsexi mɨkɨkɨ retaxatɨanike, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —'Erirari, Merari hamatɨa mekatenekuxatatɨweni temakuteitsie.
Kutsuhexi Nuni nu'aya, ti'uximayatame manayexeiyarie Muitsexi parewiwameyakɨ temaikɨyari paitɨ, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Muitsexi, neti'aitɨwame, keniwaruta'imaiya.
Muitsexi mɨpaɨta kaniutayɨni: —¿Nekɨmana peti'ɨtetsa? Mɨpaɨ nepɨtiku'eriwakaku yunaitɨ 'ikɨ Yawé teɨterimama 'iyari mepexeiyanikeku memɨtekuxatanikɨ.
Hikɨ Muitsexi meta 'ukirawetsixi mekaniu'axɨani mematitekaitsie.
Xɨ'aurixi

Yawé 'eka kaniuyuitɨani xɨ'aurixi haramaratsie miemete waratɨkɨme, mematiteitsie kaniwarukaxɨrieni. Memakuteitsie wa'aurie xɨ'aurixi mekanakunɨkaitɨni, xeitukari 'umietɨ ranuyenakeme me'atayeutɨ, xeimeturuyari metsuitɨ kwiepa.
'Ixaheritsixi mekaniwarukuteɨxɨ xɨ'aurixi mɨkɨ tukaritsie meta naime mɨkɨ tɨkaritsie meta 'uxa'arieka. Yunaitɨ tamamata 'ikayari mekaniukuxeɨrieni. Memakuteitsie takwa yateewa mekaniwarutiwatsiɨxa.
Hikɨ kepauka memeitakwaixɨa yuteta meka'itikeiwawekaku 'akuxi, Yawé kaniuyeha'ani 'ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme, 'ana yuwaɨkawatɨ mekaniukwini.
'Ayumieme mana mekateniuterɨwa Kiwuruti-Hatawa, mana memukateukiekɨ 'ikwaitsie xeikɨa memɨyukɨhɨawekaikɨ.
Mana Kiwuruti-Hatawa memɨyekɨ 'ixaheritsixi, mekanekɨne pɨta Katseruti mana mekaniuyuhayewa.
